cells: legacy_reconnaissance.md Q3 cache fact (time editor sentence)
findings.observed: In an es session the time editor displays and saves with format.datetime "dd-MM-yyyy HH:MM " (month letters in the minutes position, trailing space). Input typed as the hint "DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM" reads passes validation and then fails with HTTP 500 (ParseException at UpdateTimeAction.java:145); nothing is saved. Input in the Insert Time shape is saved with the minutes replaced (12:09 -> 12:00). en and de round trips are unchanged.
findings.expected: Carried pass-012 F-003: display and Insert Time follow the session locale, validation the server default; a day/month swap may be misread or rejected. Rows 149/152 describe a redirect or a "Can't parse" message.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 70 D/F: add that the es time editor save parses with the session pattern including its trailing space, so hint-shaped input ends in an HTTP 500 general error page and Insert-Time-shaped input loses its minutes. Rows 149 and 152 H: note that in es sessions an unparsable-by-session-pattern value passes TimeEditorForm validation and fails in UpdateTimeAction (500) instead of the message. Q3 time-editor sentence: name the time editor display and Insert Time as session-locale consumers.

findings.observed: GET /do/edit/task/estimate answers 200 with an empty body; no page is shown. The estimate change and its history entry work only through a direct POST to /do/edit/time with action=UPDATE_ESTIMATE.
findings.expected: A page that shows actual and estimated hours and submits a new estimate.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 161 D/F: the URL returns an empty 200 response (plain Struts Action, no forward); the estimate update and "reestimated" history are reachable only by a direct POST of the editTaskEstimate.jsp fields to /do/edit/time.

findings.observed: An unparsable period date on the personal and aggregate timesheets shows no message; the page returns with the default week 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03.
findings.minimal_correction: Rows 163 and 166 F: no message is displayed; the form falls back to the default period (the timesheet pages have no html:errors output). Keep the validate() fact in H as static.

findings.observed: Every note save with a file attachment fails with HTTP 500: foreign key noteAttachments (note.attachment_id -> xfile.id) violated during the batch insert; no note or downloadable file is stored. Observed on this deployment (Tomcat 9 / JRE 8, MySQL 5.7); the original runtime is not established.
findings.expected: The note with its attachment is saved and downloadable.
findings.minimal_correction: Rows 169 and 172 F: record that attachment upload fails in the reference deployment with the note->xfile foreign key violation (runtime observed); rows 170 (file case), 171 and 175 stay unverified until an attachment can be stored.

findings.observed: A note editor submission that fails validation (missing subject, author, or body without a file) answers HTTP 500 java.lang.AbstractMethodError MultipartRequestWrapper.getServletContext(); no message is shown. Container-dependent (Servlet 3+ container with the bundled Struts 1.2 multipart wrapper).
findings.minimal_correction: Row 170 F: on the reference deployment the validation messages are never shown; the multipart editor fails with HTTP 500 (AbstractMethodError) when validation fails.

findings.observed: Editing a note as a non-administrator posts the editing user as authorId (hidden field) and reassigns the note's author on save.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 173 F: the author of an edited note becomes the editing user for editors without the author select (editNote.jsp hidden authorId).

findings.observed: The delete link (after the confirm prompt) answers 302 to returnto, but the note is not removed (editor and viewer requests).
findings.expected: Note removed; its file removed unless referenced.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 174 F: record that /do/delete/note redirects without deleting the note on the reference deployment (runtime observed); the file-cascade claim stays static.

findings.observed: An empty header search shows the general error page "An error has occurred." without the message text in en and de sessions.
findings.expected: "Invalid content specified for search.: missing content".
findings.minimal_correction: Row 181 F: the general error page is shown without the contentsearch.invalid_id text (only "An error has occurred.").

findings.observed: History column headings (and other dt:table column titles built with messages.getMessage) are always in the server default locale (English), while the page title and h1 follow the session locale; es has no history keys and falls back to English.
findings.expected: Row 186 records only the date format as locale-dependent.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 186 F/H: add that the column headings use MessageResources#getMessage(String) and therefore the server default locale for every user (history.jsp:52-63, 97-111), while the heading texts follow the session bundle.

findings.observed: Task Move and Continue fail with HTTP 500 "No Hibernate Session bound to thread" (MoveContinueTaskAction.saveForm), so these entry points write no history on the reference deployment; the other listed web entry points write history as recorded.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 187 F: note that the task move/continue entry points fail before saving (runtime observed), so no task history is written by them; cross-reference rows 144-145 (part B scope).
